separate_coco_semantic_from_panoptic: create semantic segmentation annotations from COCO panoptic segmentation annotations for PanopticFPN
process_panoptic_to_semantic: convert a single panoptic PNG image to a semantic segmentation image using an id map
run_prepare_panoptic_fpn: run the script to generate semantic annotations from COCO panoptic data for train and val splits
link_val100: create symbolic links for a 100-image subset of panoptic validation data for quick testing
download_panoptic_val2017_100: download the panoptic val2017_100 annotation JSON file from the Detectron2 public file server
